description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell: short wooden plank walkway segment on posts, wooden mooring post with rope, fish drying rack, clay storage pot, lantern hanging on a pole, swamp wooden signpost, small wooden canoe, basket of herbs, stack of bundled reeds, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
